title: UrbanROI: Causal Modeling for Regional ROI Forecasting under POI Entry
abstract: arXiv:2611.20180v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As urban commercial environments continue to evolve rapidly, accurately modeling the economic impact of point of interest (POI) entry is essential for supporting data-driven advertising allocation, merchant onboarding, and regional business decision-making. Existing return on investment (ROI) prediction methods mainly focus on individual ads or merchants, overlooking the interaction effects among POIs and failing to capture the causal influence of structural changes in urban commercial ecosystems. In this paper, we introduce a novel research problem -- regional ROI forecasting under POI entry, which aims to predict the future ROI trajectory of a commercial region after the introduction of a new POI by modeling temporal ROI evolution and competition-driven interactions among surrounding POIs. To address these challenges, we propose UrbanROI, an intervention-aware causal forecasting framework for region-level economic outcome prediction. U

translated_title: UrbanROI：面向POI入驻场景的区域ROI预测因果建模
translated_abstract: 随着城市商业环境的持续快速演变，准确建模兴趣点（POI）入驻的经济影响，对于支持数据驱动的广告投放分配、商户入驻引导以及区域商业决策至关重要。现有的投资回报率（ROI）预测方法主要聚焦于单个广告或商户，忽视了POI之间的交互效应，也未能捕捉城市商业生态系统中结构性变化所带来的因果影响。在本文中，我们提出了一个新颖的研究问题——POI入驻下的区域ROI预测，旨在通过建模ROI的时间演化以及周边POI之间由竞争驱动的相互作用，预测新POI入驻后商业区域未来的ROI变化轨迹。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了UrbanROI，一个面向区域级经济结果预测的、具备干预感知能力的因果预测框架。
tldr: 本文首次提出“POI入驻下的区域ROI预测”这一新研究问题，并设计了干预感知的因果预测框架UrbanROI，通过建模ROI时间演化与周边POI间的竞争交互，实现对新POI入驻后区域经济回报走势的准确预测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces UrbanROI, an intervention-aware causal forecasting framework that defines the novel problem of regional ROI forecasting under POI entry, capturing temporal ROI evolution and competition-driven interactions among surrounding POIs to predict a commercial region's economic trajectory after a new POI is introduced.
